notes.title: Steam Game Awards 2024 Badge
notes.content:
Hello players,

[h3][u]Do you know that in just max 5 minutes you can[/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/fa2c17bbdab2eb283571d4a1fee7965c2975d4e7.jpg[/img]

[olist]
[*] Support developers of this game
[*] Get a cool Steam Awards Community badge that boosts your Steam level
[*] Be happy to be involved in a Community Event
[*] Be one of the chosen to create a great community of players
[/olist]

[u]You just need to:[/u]

[b]1. [/b]Nominate the game of your choice for the award

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/2220956f7f46f0791840f21607a665909825c890.jpg[/img]

You just go to the game Steam card and there will be a banner just under the trailers/screenshots section.

[b]2.[/b] Nominate other games ideally one of the FreeMind games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/0c9eead3ebeae09916fa8ae1c5c99b9942ebb00d.png[/img]

You go to the main Steam page and click on the banner above, nominate a game of your choice.

[b]3.[/b] Create or update a review of the game

[b]4. [/b]Start and play the nominated game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/7fc9558d463c0eab92caed37366389e22c4b0596.jpg[/img]

If you are having problems, just let us know we will try to help.

FreeMind team.

[h3]PS. If you want to support us and you think our game/s deserves a nomination, you can do your badge just with us, though it would be quite impressive if you held all of our titles.[/h3]

Here is just an example that CreativeForge Games can be nominated in 10 out of 11 categories

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/537e50d006e5462df2fe616ea052bc09015842eb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 🎉 "Chupacabra Hunt" is officially live! 🎮
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939900/Chupacabra_Hunt/?curator_clanid=4777282][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022376/3468a4a0f258a3ae55de0066aace20322ceaa58b.png[/img][/url]

After months of hard work and passion, our latest game is now available on Steam! Now's your chance to embark on an exciting journey, uncovering the mysteries of the legendary Chupacabra in this thrilling adventure. 🦇🌲

[b]To celebrate the launch, you can grab the game with a 10% discount for a limited time! [/b]🤑 Don’t miss out on this opportunity to dive into the hunt at a great price.

We encourage you to immerse yourself in this unique world full of challenges. Your support and feedback are crucial to us – leave a comment and share your thoughts. Every bit of feedback helps us improve the game and deliver even more excitement in the future.

[b]We also invite you to join our Discord![/b] 📢 It's the perfect place to share your insights and ideas directly with the developer, as well as connect with other players and exchange experiences. 

Join us here: https://discord.gg/QmqCf4rwVx

Don't wait – start the hunt now! 🔥
